bull.probability_evidence: Morgan Stanley elevated NetEase to Top Pick ahead of Ananta's January global launch, calling it a 'landmark' title with 'potential global impact' (fact sheet News & sentiment, GuruFocus/TheFly, 2026-09-28), and operating margin is still rising (35.2% TTM vs 18.7% FY2021, fact sheet Quality table); weighted below base because the stock has not traded at its 5y median P/FCF since its -21.6% 12-month decline (evaluation.md bull basis; fact sheet Price table).

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Valuation table: P/FCF 5y min/median/max = 10.7x/12.3x/17.9x [RA]; band = (17.9-10.7)/(2*12.3), the multiple the bull target re-rates to

base.probability_evidence: EV/EBITDA (8.2x) and P/FCF (10.1x) already sit below every one of their own 5-year fiscal-year-end levels (fact sheet Valuation table) while VIEs still carried 85.2% of FY2025 revenue (note section 2, source 20-F) -- the discount is structural, favouring only partial mean reversion rather than a full re-rating or a further de-rating.

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Valuation table: P/FCF 5y min/median/max = 10.7x/12.3x/17.9x [RA]; band = (17.9-10.7)/(2*10.7), the multiple the base target recovers to

bear.probability_evidence: Net debt/EBITDA of -3.76x (net cash) and a 9.86% FCF yield (fact sheet Quality/Valuation tables) give downside protection even if a PRC monetization/loot-box rule change or a weak Ananta launch (note section 6/4, source 20-F; evaluation.md bear basis) materialises, capping this scenario's weight below bull and base.

target_band.cite: Fact sheet Valuation table: P/E 5y min/median/max = 13.6x/15.4x/24.8x [RA]; band = (24.8-13.6)/(2*13.6), the multiple the bear target compresses to
